problem: Can a proper compression of the atomic depth-three defect register support every grade-selective intervention and the terminal total readout?
bold_conjecture: The atomic register is the minimal substrate for all independent grade-selective interventions; scalar cumulative data cannot replace it.

task_contract.descent_requirement: for quotient kernel K, every E_j preserves K and K is contained in ker epsilon

disposition.proper_compression: no admissible kernel under the declared task contract
